answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor that must forge a fresh signed proof every epoch, and let standing accrue only as several already-established peers from separate funding clusters co-sign audited work. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares one root, so its endorsements fold back on themselves and never span distinct clusters; they run aground on a reef of missing cross-cluster signatures and stay dim as an uncut opal. Forging 100 heads costs 100 anchors plus 100 slow climbs, while an honest agent pays once.
